unsupervised text normalization can be performed using distributed representations of words and phrases.

1) unsupervised distributed representations of words can be used for text normalization; 2) unsupervised phrase normalization lexicons can be learned by training distributed representations of words over compound words.

(i) we learn distributed representations of noisy and canonical forms from noisy text collections, and (ii) we learn normalization lexicons using the distributed representations in an unsupervised manner.
